# Dry Heat Yards

> Dry Heat Yards (dryheatyards.com) is a free Arizona directory of landscaping contractors. Every contractor listed holds an active Arizona Registrar of Contractors (ROC) license, re-checked monthly. Homeowners call pros directly; there are no lead fees. Weed control companies are listed separately and are matched to an active Arizona Department of Agriculture pest control license (category 3, Ornamental & Turf).

Key facts:
- Coverage: 22 Arizona cities plus Western Arizona, with 600+ licensed landscaping, weed control and pool companies.
- Listings show the ROC license number, Google rating and review count (as of the date shown), and a phone number.
- Google ratings are from each business's Google profile, not reviews collected by Dry Heat Yards.
- Free tools: landscape rock calculator (tons of rock needed), weed calendar, monthly yard to-do list.
